description: This file defines the PHP class InboundEmailViewDetail which extends ViewDetail and overrides the display method to assign variables to the view for rendering the detail view of inbound email messages in SuiteCRM.

classes.name: InboundEmailViewDetail
classes.description: A class extending ViewDetail responsible for rendering the detail view of inbound email records in SuiteCRM. Overrides the display method to assign user-specific variables to the view.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides the parent display method to assign 'is_admin' and 'current_user_id' variables to the view context before calling the parent display method.
